infoPlist.NSUserNotificationUsageDescription: Habyss uses notifications to remind you about your habits and help you stay consistent.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Habyss needs access to your photos to let you set custom backgrounds for your goals.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This identifier will be used to deliver personalized content and improve your experience.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Habyss uses FaceID to securely authenticate your access.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Habyss uses calendar access to schedule habit reminders and sync with your calendar events.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Habyss needs your location to send reminders when you arrive at specific places like Home or Work.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Habyss needs your location to send reminders when you arrive at specific places like Home or Work.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Habyss uses the microphone when you choose to speak, such as holding the create button to add a habit, task or goal by voice, or talking to Echo.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Habyss reads your sleep from Apple Health — from Apple Watch, Garmin, Oura, Whoop or any sleep tracker — to fill in your sleep habits. Nothing else is read.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Habyss does not write to Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Habyss uses motion data together with your location to time place-based reminders accurately.
infoPlist.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Habyss can play your music during focus sessions.
infoPlist.NSSiriUsageDescription: Habyss lets you log habits and tasks with Siri and Shortcuts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Habyss needs your location to send reminders when you arrive at specific places like Home or Work.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Habyss turns what you say into a habit, task or goal when you hold the create button and speak.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you set custom profile pictures and goal backgrounds.
plugins.cameraPermission: The app accesses your camera to let you take profile pictures and goal backgrounds.

plugins.calendarPermission: The app needs to access your calendar to sync habits.
plugins.remindersPermission: The app needs to access your reminders to sync habits.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Habyss uses Face ID to unlock your private habits when App Lock is enabled.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Habyss uses your saved places to remind you about habits when you arrive, even when the app is closed.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Save your current location for an optional habit arrival reminder.

plugins.microphonePermission: Habyss uses the microphone when you choose to speak, such as holding the create button to add a habit, task or goal by voice, or talking to Echo.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Habyss turns what you say into a habit, task or goal when you hold the create button and speak.
